literal_meaning: ঘরের লক্ষ্মী (house's Lakshmi, referring to the goddess of prosperity in the home)
figurative_meaning_en: Housewife or ideal wife who brings prosperity and harmony to the home
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সত্যিই আমাদের ঘরের লক্ষ্মী, সবসময় সংসার সুখী রাখে।
বিয়ের পর সে ঘরের লক্ষ্মী হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is truly the Lakshmi of our home, always keeping the family happy.
After marriage, she became the ideal housewife.
history: Derived from Hindu mythology where Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth and fortune, symbolizing the wife as the bringer of household prosperity.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on women's roles in maintaining family well-being, often used affectionately.
